unit.why: The division is a compiler's collection of eighteen homiletic teachings by his father R. Mordekhai Ze'ev of Kalbiel on Torah portions, Talmudic passages and the end of the Mishnah, with no narrative events.
unit.boundary_note: Contains interleaved text from the end of the previous division (the Kozhnitz Maggid's teaching on charity, 'עוד *אמר המאסף... ירחם עלינו ועכ״י אס״ו'), apparently a page-order or footnote displacement. The brief retelling of R. Yohanan and Resh Lakish (Bava Metzia) is only an illustration inside a teaching, not a story.
